_about: SYNTHETIC. Hand-derived (no iPhone was involved) from apps/ios/SandtableBeacon/Models.swift (WireDevice, WireObservation, WireReport: Swift property names are the JSON keys; nil optionals are OMITTED by the synthesized Encodable, never sent as null) and Reporter.swift (buildBatch: for every board key in sorted order its uwb, sos and bearing observations, then one report; every observation carries the eid; a board's latest reading is re-sent with the time it was MEASURED for up to 25 s; prev_eid only after the random id rotated, until one batch is accepted; bye on Stop sharing). Distances put the phone at phone_truth with the two pucks of placement (the server's recommended door-wall layout for r310). Accessory keys are examples: the boards' real advertised name is not confirmed. Times are absolute Unix seconds as the app sends them; tests/test_ios_wire.py shifts them all by one constant so they are recent. Number spelling (-61 or -61.0, 1794679209 or 1794679209.0) depends on the iOS Foundation version; both parse the same.

batches.name: b1_one_board
batches.what: First batch after I NEED HELP: one board (P1) ranged so far, its distance and Bluetooth signal, the person's report (note typed, suite and floor set in Setup).

report.text: Two of us in the back office, smoke under the door

batches.name: b2_take_turns_second_board
batches.what: Taking turns: P1 was released (its last distance and signal are re-sent with their ORIGINAL t, so the server must count them once), P2 is now ranged.

report.text: Two of us in the back office, smoke under the door

batches.name: b3_eid_rotated_with_bearing
batches.what: The random id rotated (every 10 minutes; compressed here): every observation carries the NEW eid, the report carries prev_eid until one batch is accepted. The experimental camera-assisted bearing is on, so P2 also gets a bearing. The person changed status to injured and cleared the note (text omitted).

batches.name: b4_i_am_out
batches.what: "I am out": status ok with safe_outside true; prev_eid gone (b3 was accepted); bearing toggle off again; P1's reading and P2's signal are repeats for this eid (skipped), P2's distance is new.

batches.name: b5_bye
batches.what: Stop sharing: one bye observation, nothing else.
